integrity: Analytic proof with fully specified Fourier and area normalizations; a standalone finite checker is supplied and does not independently certify the infinite assertions. Novelty and historical priority are assessed only against inspected sources, and have not been independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Proven for Gaussian-window radial masks whose one-dimensional squared-radius supports satisfy initial-window mass domination, in particular every finite middle-third Cantor iterate at every positive radius. Does not cover arbitrary digit alphabets, non-Gaussian windows, or arbitrary disconnected supports; the explicit positive gap is not claimed optimal.
title: Exact Gaussian spectral dominance for every radial middle-third Cantor mask
